queer_characters.name: Laila Kapoor
queer_characters.notes: Laila explicitly identifies as bisexual, is attracted to a male classmate (Jared) and in a serious relationship with a woman (Khanum), and comes out to her mother. Reviewers praised the normalized portrayal alongside her cerebral palsy.

queer_characters.name: Khanum
queer_characters.notes: A blind activist in a serious romantic relationship with Laila; the source text confirms the same-gender relationship but does not give Khanum a specific orientation label, so the umbrella term is used.

contributor_notes: Laila's bisexuality is explicit in the plot; Khanum's specific label isn't stated in the source, so 'queer' umbrella is used pending review.
